# 10 shares sold for 2,600.00 CAD out of an account holding none of them.
#
# A share account below zero is not read as owing shares: what a split brings
# in past zero is read for currency alone, which is all Q-047 is about. So the
# sale opens no cost basis, as it did before, and the share account stays on
# the held side of the balance sheet.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 commodity AMZN
	mnemonic: "AMZN"
	fullname: "Amazon.com Inc"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000
2034-02-01 open Assets:AMZN
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"

2034-02-01 * "Sell 10 AMZN before any were bought"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:AMZN -10 AMZN
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
		share_price: "260"
		value: "-2600.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank 2600.00 CAD
